test.syllabus: This test contains questions from all topics of this chapter included in the JEE Main syllabus. It includes a mix of questions from PYQs of JEE Main 2019 - 2025.

question.text: Let the vectors <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mover><msub><mi>u</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>=</mo><mover><mi>i</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>+</mo><mover><mi>j</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>+</mo><mi>a</mi><mover><mi>k</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>,</mo><mo> </mo><mover><msub><mi>u</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>=</mo><mover><mi>i</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>+</mo><mi>b</mi><mover><mi>j</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>+</mo><mover><mi>k</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>,</mo></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mover><msub><mi>u</mi><mn>3</mn></msub><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>=</mo><mi>c</mi><mover><mi>i</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>+</mo><mover><mi>j</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>+</mo><mover><mi>k</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo> </mo></math> be coplanar.
